newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia hopes to connect with European road system.
newsitem.headline: Croatia hopes to connect with European road system.

text.p: Croatia said on Sunday it expects to win approval to connect its road network with Europe's main road corridors at the All European Transport Conference in Helsinki on Tuesday, the state news agency Hina reported.
"We are going to become a part of the European road network and become able to participate in its traffic policy," Mijo Petek, secretary of the Transport Ministry, told Hina.

He said Croatia hoped it could tap into road corridors running from Budapest via Sarajevo to its southern Adriatic port of Ploce, from Budapest to its main northern Adriatic port of Rijeka, and from Graz to Zagreb.

Petek said an entirely new connection linking Salzburg in Austria with Ljubljana in Slovenia, Zagreb and on to the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, Macedonia and Greece was also mentioned in preliminary talks.

"If we are not accepted, that would be a great surprise," Petek said, adding that the All European Traffic Conference should offer Croatia a chance to leave behind the isolation in which it has been since the last conference in Crete in 1994.
Croatia is keen to become a part of the European Union as soon as possible and sees road connections as an important part of the integration process.
